blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte has not declared any cash on hand and in bank from the years 2019 to 2025 in her Statements of Assets Liabilities and Net Worth (SALNs), a prosecution witness said Tuesday. Officer-in-Charge of the Records Division from the Ombudsman’s office lawyer Karen Batu said this before the Senate sitting as an impeachment court on the 25th day of Duterte’s trial. As the Ombudsman serves as the official repository for SALNs of all public officials, Batu was called to confirm the veracity of Duterte’s SALNs from 2007 to 2025, from when Duterte served as Davao […]...
